title: UL-17 — Challenge: Athena on a tiny file
scenario: Convert Athena query results to Parquet (or similar), verify, delete outputs.
acceptanceCriteria: Name the resources you create `workbook-ul17`: bucket `workbook-ul17-<account-id>` (prefixes `raw/`, `converted/`, `results/`), Athena database `workbook_ul17`, and workgroup `workbook-ul17` or crawler `workbook-ul17` if you create one. Tag each one LabId=ul-17.
CSV source data in s3:// bucket prefix.
Athena query creates CTAS or INSERT output format change (e.g., Parquet).
Output prefix distinct from raw data prefix.
Second query reads converted format successfully.
Query scan size noted for cost.
Athena workgroup default or named documented.
stopChargesPanel: Drop the Athena database and tables, delete the optional workgroup and crawler, then empty and delete the ul-17 bucket.

orderedDeletesPowerShell: # Lost track? List what is left: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-17
# DROP ... CASCADE drops the database and every table in it. The loop waits for the query to finish before the results prefix is deleted.

$QueryId = aws athena start-query-execution --query-string 'DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS workbook_ul17 CASCADE' --result-configuration OutputLocation=s3://$Bucket/results/ --query QueryExecutionId --output text

if ($QueryId) { $i = 0; do { Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $QueryState = aws athena get-query-execution --query-execution-id $QueryId --query QueryExecution.Status.State --output text; $i++ } while (($QueryState -eq 'QUEUED' -or $QueryState -eq 'RUNNING') -and $i -lt 60); if ($i -ge 60) { Write-Host 'Timed out waiting for DROP DATABASE to finish after 60 tries; check the Athena console' }; $QueryState }
$WorkGroup = aws athena get-work-group --work-group workbook-ul17 --query WorkGroup.Name --output text
$Crawler = aws glue get-crawler --name workbook-ul17 --query Crawler.Name --output text
verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-17 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
The DROP DATABASE query state printed by the teardown is SUCCEEDED
aws glue get-database --name workbook_ul17 returns EntityNotFoundException
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=ul-17 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-17. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

beforeYouStart: Read the paired guided lab (gl-17) stop-charges panel before you create anything.
Set $env:AWS_PROFILE and $env:AWS_REGION. Do not use the root user.
